body: Use case stylized-concept. Production game CUTOUT CHARACTER sprite atlas on transparent background. Clean cel shaded hand-painted 2D fantasy, crisp dark contours and readable shapes. Subject Agile forest Archer in moss green leather tunic and pointed green feathered hood cap, visible human face, short russet hair, tan forearm bracers, brown belt and boots, dark green short cape. No bow, arrows or quiver on body sheet. Exact tall atlas layout: SIX columns, TWELVE rows, 72 isolated pieces total. Each column is a real different direction: E right side, SE front right three-quarter, SW front left three-quarter, W left side, NW back left three-quarter, NE back right three-quarter. Each row exactly one anatomical piece, order top to bottom: HEAD, TORSO WITHOUT HEAD OR ARMS, detached CAPE, PELVIS belt-and-hips, LEFT UPPER ARM, RIGHT UPPER ARM, LEFT FOREARM WITH HAND, RIGHT FOREARM WITH HAND, LEFT LEG WITHOUT BOOT, RIGHT LEG WITHOUT BOOT, LEFT BOOT, RIGHT BOOT. Flat neutral straight poses. Every piece separate with generous alpha-zero gaps. No assembled character, no weapons, no duplicated head on torso, no labels, no grid, no background, no shadows. 1024x1536 portrait. Six genuine rotated views, consistent anatomy and clothing.
equipment: Use case stylized-concept. Production transparent 2D fantasy equipment sprite atlas for archer. Clean cel shaded painted fantasy with crisp ink contours. THREE rows of six items. Row1 tall simple curved wood longbow with thin taut bowstring, grip at center. Row2 single wooden arrow with ivory feather fletching and steel tip pointing up. Row3 brown leather back quiver holding arrows. Columns rotate equipment to match E,SE,SW,W,NW,NE. Exact18 isolated pieces. Six equally spaced columns, generous margins, detached objects only, no hands or characters, no text, no grid, no background haze. Landscape1536x1024. All pieces clean alpha transparent.
effects: Use case stylized-concept. Production 2D game VFX sheet for forest archer, clean cel shaded fantasy style, fully transparent background. Exact6columns4rows grid, 24separateframes, no text or grid lines. Four rows six frames: row1 slender wooden arrow projectile pointingRIGHT ivory fletching; row2 small wood/ivory arrow impact sparks; row3 gentle green leaf arrival puff; row4 short taut white bowstring release glint. Every row is six successive animationframes expanding/animating then fading. Keep each within its cell, generous transparent margins. No opaque background, no fullcanvasglow. Landscape1536x1024.
